messages.subject: serious bug in Stan 2.10
parts:
Upper and lower bounds are not working. I'm not sure
yet if this bug extends to other constrained variables, but
in the meantime, I would strongly suggest reverting to
Stan 2.9 until we make a verified fix and a new release.

We have extensive unit tests, but obviously didn't cover
this simple case. We'll make sure to fix the tests so this
issue can't recur without us catching it before releasing.

I'm very very sorry this cropped up. I thought it'd be
better to let everyone know than try to ignore it.

Thanks for your patience while we fix this. It's now our
number one priority.

- Bob
